speaker: Daniel
text: Despite her success in the film domain, the roles she most preferred portraying were not in movies. She was an exemplary mother to her two sons and a UNICEF (the United Nations International Children's Emergency Fund) Goodwill Ambassador serving victims in war-torn countries.
